card.summary: A 24-hour trial of the entry plan, Ayoo VPS I (2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 50 GB NVMe), on request: order the plan without paying the invoice, open a ticket or message...

free_tier.stated: A 24-hour trial of the entry plan, Ayoo VPS I (2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 50 GB NVMe), on request: order the plan without paying the invoice, open a ticket or message support, and the machine is activated if an IPv4 block is free; it is suspended after 24 hours and deleted a day later unless paid.
free_tier.notes: one machine, one request; activation is manual and queued on IPv4 supply, so it is a trial and not a standing allowance

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a virtual machine, not a stored object

retention.stated: A trial machine is suspended after 24 hours and deleted one day later unless the invoice is paid; a paid machine persists while the monthly invoice is paid. The terms place backups and data recovery on the customer.
retention.notes: two days from creation for a trial; indefinite while paid

egress.terms: Transfer is advertised as unlimited on every plan ('Transf. Mensal: Ilimitada', 'Transferência ilimitada'); the terms require the customer to respect technical limits and avoid abuse of processing, I/O and network, and state no number.

record.interface_detail: root SSH on the Linux images and RDP on the Windows images; the AyooPanel web console handles power, reinstall, password, backup and VNC; no API is documented on the vendor pages
record.tooling: any OpenSSH client for a Linux image, an RDP client for Windows, and the AyooPanel console; no provider CLI, SDK or documented API
record.chaining: A 24-hour root machine in Canada with a dedicated IPv4 and unlimited transfer covers a job that needs a full OS and an inbound port for one day; anything longer starts at BRL 49.90 a month, so the offer is a route to Brazilian payment rails and a Canadian address rather than a cheap standing host.

limits.value: no traffic quota: 'Transf. Mensal: Ilimitada' on every plan, bounded only by the terms' rule against network abuse

record.limits_note: The 24-hour window is a time allowance rather than a byte allowance; no limit kind names time, so it is carried in the free-tier unit (hours) and in the session cap.
record.binding_note: Nothing in the allowance binds, because transfer is unlimited and there is no traffic counter; the CPF or CNPJ demanded at registration is what stops a registrant without a Brazilian tax number.

identity_cost.detail: The registration form marks a CPF or CNPJ as required ('CNPJ/CPF*', 'Digite o CNPJ para pessoa Jurídica, CPF para pessoa física'), alongside email, a phone number and a billing address; card payments may prompt a document request. Payment is Pix, boleto or credit or debit card.

record.reliability_note: The 24-hour trial is granted by ticket and queued on IPv4 supply, so activation can wait; the terms disclaim data recovery and put backups on the customer; the service is run by a single Brazilian company, CNPJ 69.734.466/0001-17.
record.confidence_note: Trial, price, identity gate and transfer term are each quoted from a first-party page captured; the trial itself was not requested, so activation and the queue are unobserved.
